title: Staging jobs and backups
description: Every CronJob on the staging cluster: freshness against its schedule, failures, run times and running Jobs, with payment jobs (dispatchers, reconciliation, financial backlogs) and backups called out.

list.name: Deployment rollouts
list.expr: max by (namespace, deployment, replicaset) (max by (namespace, replicaset) (kube_replicaset_created{namespace=~"staging-ns"}) * on (namespace, replicaset) group_left (deployment) max by (namespace, replicaset, deployment) (label_replace(kube_replicaset_owner{namespace=~"staging-ns", owner_kind="Deployment"}, "deployment", "$1", "owner_name", "(.*)"))) * 1000

targets.expr: count(max by (namespace, cronjob) (kube_cronjob_spec_suspend{namespace=~"$namespace"}) == 0)

panels.title: Overdue
panels.description: Active CronJobs that have missed at least one scheduled run since their last success.

targets.expr: count((clamp_min(floor((time() - (max by (namespace, cronjob) (kube_cronjob_status_last_successful_time{namespace=~"$namespace"}) or max by (namespace, cronjob) (kube_cronjob_created{namespace=~"$namespace"}))) / ((max by (namespace, cronjob) (kube_cronjob_next_schedule_time{namespace=~"$namespace"}) - max by (namespace, cronjob) (kube_cronjob_status_last_schedule_time{namespace=~"$namespace"})) > 0)) - 1, 0) unless on (namespace, cronjob) (max by (namespace, cronjob) (kube_cronjob_spec_suspend{namespace=~"$namespace"}) == 1)) >= 1) or vector(0)

panels.title: Failed runs
panels.description: Jobs created in the selected range that ended in failure.

targets.expr: sum(count by (namespace, cronjob) ((((label_replace(((max by (namespace, job_name) (max_over_time(kube_job_failed{namespace=~"$namespace", job_name=~"(.+)-[0-9]{8,}", condition="true"}[$__range])) == 1) and on (namespace, job_name) (max by (namespace, job_name) (max_over_time(kube_job_created{namespace=~"$namespace", job_name=~"(.+)-[0-9]{8,}"}[$__range])) > (time() - $__range_s))), "cronjob", "$1", "job_name", "(.+)-[0-9]{8,}")) or (((max by (namespace, job_name) (max_over_time(kube_job_failed{namespace=~"$namespace", job_name!~"(.+)-[0-9]{8,}", condition="true"}[$__range])) == 1) and on (namespace, job_name) (max by (namespace, job_name) (max_over_time(kube_job_created{namespace=~"$namespace", job_name!~"(.+)-[0-9]{8,}"}[$__range])) > (time() - $__range_s))) * on (namespace, job_name) group_left (cronjob) max by (namespace, job_name, cronjob) (label_replace(max_over_time(kube_job_owner{namespace=~"$namespace", owner_kind="CronJob", job_name!~"(.+)-[0-9]{8,}"}[$__range]), "cronjob", "$1", "owner_name", "(.*)")))) and on (namespace, cronjob) max by (namespace, cronjob) (kube_cronjob_info{namespace=~"$namespace"}))) or max by (namespace, cronjob) (kube_cronjob_info{namespace=~"$namespace"}) * 0) or vector(0)
sum(kube_cronjob_status_active{namespace=~"$namespace"}) or vector(0)

panels.title: Payment dispatch freshness
panels.description: Longest time since the last success across the refund, invoicing and Stripe webhook dispatchers (every minute). Their stale alerts fire at 900 s.

targets.expr: max((time() - (max by (namespace, cronjob) (kube_cronjob_status_last_successful_time{namespace=~"$namespace", cronjob=~"staging-api-(refund-dispatch|invoicing-dispatch|stripe-webhook-dispatch)"}) or max by (namespace, cronjob) (kube_cronjob_created{namespace=~"$namespace", cronjob=~"staging-api-(refund-dispatch|invoicing-dispatch|stripe-webhook-dispatch)"}))))

panels.title: Financial backlog
panels.description: Items waiting in the Stripe reconciliation, refund recovery and fiscal review backlogs (financial-health collector).

targets.expr: sum(only_chance_financial_backlog_items) or vector(0)

panels.title: Oldest backup
panels.description: Time since the least recent successful backup across PostgreSQL (api, blog, keycloak, windmill) and LibreDesk. Backups run nightly; the stale alerts fire at 26 hours.

targets.expr: max((time() - (max by (namespace, cronjob) (kube_cronjob_status_last_successful_time{namespace=~"$namespace", cronjob=~".*backup.*"}) or max by (namespace, cronjob) (kube_cronjob_created{namespace=~"$namespace", cronjob=~".*backup.*"}))))

panels.title: Failed backups
panels.description: Backup Jobs created in the selected range that failed.

targets.expr: sum(count by (namespace, cronjob) ((((label_replace(((max by (namespace, job_name) (max_over_time(kube_job_failed{namespace=~"$namespace", job_name=~"(.*backup.*)-[0-9]{8,}", condition="true"}[$__range])) == 1) and on (namespace, job_name) (max by (namespace, job_name) (max_over_time(kube_job_created{namespace=~"$namespace", job_name=~"(.*backup.*)-[0-9]{8,}"}[$__range])) > (time() - $__range_s))), "cronjob", "$1", "job_name", "(.+)-[0-9]{8,}")) or (((max by (namespace, job_name) (max_over_time(kube_job_failed{namespace=~"$namespace", job_name!~"(.+)-[0-9]{8,}", condition="true"}[$__range])) == 1) and on (namespace, job_name) (max by (namespace, job_name) (max_over_time(kube_job_created{namespace=~"$namespace", job_name!~"(.+)-[0-9]{8,}"}[$__range])) > (time() - $__range_s))) * on (namespace, job_name) group_left (cronjob) max by (namespace, job_name, cronjob) (label_replace(max_over_time(kube_job_owner{namespace=~"$namespace", owner_kind="CronJob", job_name!~"(.+)-[0-9]{8,}"}[$__range]), "cronjob", "$1", "owner_name", "(.*)")))) and on (namespace, cronjob) max by (namespace, cronjob) (kube_cronjob_info{namespace=~"$namespace", cronjob=~".*backup.*"}))) or max by (namespace, cronjob) (kube_cronjob_info{namespace=~"$namespace", cronjob=~".*backup.*"}) * 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: CronJobs
panels.description: Every CronJob with its schedule, last success and missed runs (scheduled runs elapsed since the last success), plus failures and run times for Jobs created in the last 24 hours. Longest run / interval shows how close a job comes to overrunning its schedule. Fixed to 24 hours because run times scan every Job (about 11k a day); the Backups table and the panels follow the time picker.

panels.description: Seconds since each payment CronJob last succeeded. The dispatchers run every minute and alert at 900 s; Stripe reconciliation runs nightly.

targets.expr: (time() - (max by (namespace, cronjob) (kube_cronjob_status_last_successful_time{namespace=~"$namespace", cronjob=~"staging-api-(refund-dispatch|invoicing-dispatch|stripe-webhook-dispatch|stripe-reconciliation|financial-health)"}) or max by (namespace, cronjob) (kube_cronjob_created{namespace=~"$namespace", cronjob=~"staging-api-(refund-dispatch|invoicing-dispatch|stripe-webhook-dispatch|stripe-reconciliation|financial-health)"})))

panels.description: Age of the oldest waiting item per backlog kind.

panels.description: Run time of the finished Jobs Kubernetes still keeps, for the CronJobs that run every minute. They use concurrencyPolicy Forbid, so a run longer than 60 s makes the next one skip.
